metadata.description: Cross-host local CLI connectors for Codex, Grok Build, Antigravity and Claude Code.

plugins.name: codex-connector
plugins.description: Delegate bounded, git-scoped review and coding tasks to the local Codex CLI from Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build, or Antigravity.

plugins.name: grok-connector
